fulltext: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，据荣耀手机官微，全新荣耀 700 系列手机将于今天（27 日）上午 10:08 正式开售。
该系列提供晴空、粉雾、冷白、蓝调四种配色可选，拥有 IP68/IP69/IP69K 认证，厚 7.96mm，重 211g，正面配备一块 6.57 英寸 1.5K 120Hz LTPS 绿洲护眼屏，支持 AI 绿洲干眼评估。
该系列机型配备 1.59 英寸 AI 灵动背屏，手机配备影棚级柔光环，支持选择三档模式，可实现“行业独家”2 亿柔光背屏自拍功能，同时还支持 AI 互动、多样主题，以及心率、血氧检测以及航班提醒等功能。
据IT之家了解，荣耀 700 系列手机搭载 200Mp 1/1.56" 主摄（荣耀 700/Pro）、12Mp 超广角、50Mp 3.5X 潜望长焦（荣耀 700/Pro），支持全新 4K 电影感 Live 照片功能，同时拥有电影感清透人像算法，首发柔雾、薄绿两款全新人像滤镜及荣耀 AI Live 追色系统。
其中，荣耀 700 / Pro 手机支持荣耀长焦增距镜 G200，在搭配增距镜使用时，可使用 15 倍舞台 Live 模式拍摄，号称“看台也能出神图”。
性能方面，荣耀 700 搭载骁龙 8s Gen4、700S 手机搭载骁龙 7 Gen 4，而 Pro 机型搭载骁龙 8 Gen5 处理器。手机全系搭载旗舰同款射频增强芯片 C3，采用 9000mAh 青海湖电池，支持 80W 有线充电，其中 Pro 版支持 50W 无线充电。

cards.title: 消息称东京电力公司拟向人工智能基础设施领域投资超 10 万亿日元
cards.summary: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，《日本经济新闻》当地时间昨日报道称， 东京电力公司 (TEPCO) 拟在 2,035 财年内向人工智能基础设施领域投资超 10 万亿日元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 4,189.3 亿元人民币） 。 由于福岛核事故的影响，东京电力公司持续面临偿还日本政府借款等开支。 该企业认为人工智能投资能创造丰厚的收入 ， 改善自身财务结构 。另一方面，东京电力公司自身无法承担该重大投资。该企业计划向软银等投资者寻求支持。 消息指出，东京电力公司计划向电网扩建投资 4.9 万亿日元，另有 2.5 万亿日元用于核电厂扩建。为实现这一目标，需有 4 座核电站投运。

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，今日，中国科学技术大学徐铜文教授、李兴亚特任教授联合安徽大学伍斌副教授团队在《科学》（Science）期刊发表研究，揭示了一种反常识的离子传质现象。
简单来说，当共价有机框架（COF）膜的通道缩小到亚 1 纳米时，原本应传导阴离子的荷正电通道，反而表现出对阳离子的高选择性。研究团队将这一机制命名为“反离子限域（CIC）效应”。
这一发现直接挑战了膜分离领域的经典 Donnan-Manning 模型。该模型认为，荷正电通道传导阴离子，荷负电通道传导阳离子。但在亚纳米尺度下，离子与通道壁、离子与离子之间的相互作用占据主导，传递行为显著偏离宏观规律。
研究团队通过精准设计 COF 单元结构，构筑了化学环境相似、孔径不同的两种荷正电通道：亚 2 纳米的 TATGCl 膜和亚 1 纳米的 TbTGCl 膜，并系统对比了反离子的分布与动力学特性。
实验与模拟结果显示，在亚 1 纳米通道中，受限的反离子（如 Cl⁻）会重构通道壁内部的静电环境，使孔道中心呈现出显著的负电性，从而逆转了通道的整体电荷极性，将原本的阴离子选择性翻转为阳离子选择性。这种静电反转完全由反离子限域介导，而非特异性吸附所致。
更具应用价值的是，CIC 机制在混合盐体系中表现出反直觉的增强效应。在实际的复杂卤水环境中，共存离子通常会与目标离子竞争通道，导致膜的选择性显著下降。然而，CIC 效应在亚 1 纳米通道内形成了“次级限域”区域，有效抑制了共存离子的竞争。
在二元混合盐体系中，TbTGCl 膜对一价 / 多价阳离子的实际选择性不仅没有衰减，反而大幅超越单盐理想值。例如，其对 K⁺/Sc³⁺的选择性从理想值 1237 升至 4543，对 K⁺/Mg²⁺的选择性则达到 526。在模拟东台吉乃尔湖卤水（Mg²⁺/Li⁺质量比 22）的测试中，该膜对 Li⁺/Mg²⁺的选择性达到约 79。
IT之家注：COF 膜是由有机分子通过共价键连接而成的晶态多孔材料，其孔径可被精确调控至亚纳米级别，近年来被视为实现精准离子筛分的重要平台。
该研究为高盐度水处理、复杂卤水提锂等场景提供了新的膜材料设计范式，即利用反离子自身的限域行为来重构通道的静电环境，而非单纯依赖孔道尺寸或壁面电荷。
论文链接：https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aef1323

fulltext: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，昨日起，有部分 DeepSeek 用户反馈，网页端和移动端 App 内正在灰度测试“显示本轮消耗额度”功能。
用户在完成一轮对话后，界面会弹出详情页，展示本次交互消耗的 Token 数量及其对应的估算金额（价格和 API 持平）。尽管当前面向个人用户的对话服务依然免费，但该功能让单次对话背后的计算成本变得可见。
根据用户提供的截图，额度按“空闲时段”价格估算。计费拆分为三个维度：
输入缓存命中部分，单价为 0.02 元 / 百万 tokens，本轮用量约 18.5 万，折合 0.0037 元；
输入缓存未命中部分，单价为 1 元 / 百万 tokens，用量约 1.2 万，折合 0.012 元；
输出部分单价为 4 元 / 百万 tokens，用量 1470，折合 0.0058 元。
在多轮对话中，系统会缓存之前的历史上下文，后续输入时只需对“新增”部分进行全价计算，从而大幅降低长对话的累积成本。缓存命中输入（IT之家注：指模型直接复用先前计算过的上下文 K-V 缓存，避免重复计算，因此单价极低）的单价仅为未命中时的五十分之一。
此外，详情页底部还增加了一行进度提示：“截止到本轮，上下文已占用...”。该设计有助于用户直观感知当前对话的容量，当占用比例接近 100% 时，系统通常会提示或自动截断早期对话，以防超出模型的最大上下文窗口。
《DeepSeek 新一轮千亿级融资落地，梁文锋保留绝对控制权》
《DeepSeek API 定价调整：调用模型时触发服务端搜索、网页抓取不再计费，仅按模型 Token 用量计费》
《算力承压：曝 DeepSeek 应用及网页端实施限额，长对话与日额度双双受限》

cards.title: OnePlus reveals ColorOS 17 plans for native apps, paid AI features, and more
cards.title_cn: OnePlus 公布 ColorOS 17 原生应用、付费 AI 功能等计划
cards.summary: 【一加】TL;DR OnePlus is exploring wider availability of its native Phone app and plans to bring OPPO’s Calendar app to its devices. ColorOS 17 users can pay for additional AI usage or wait for their free all…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

The transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS has brought plenty of changes to OnePlus phones. And while many of our readers have warmed up to the new software, not everything has been well received by fans. From missing features to the future of native OnePlus apps, the company has now addressed some of the biggest questions surrounding ColorOS 17, revealing what users can expect from future updates and what’s already gone for good.

In a recent AMA on the OnePlus Community forum, OnePlus revealed that it’s exploring plans to bring its native dialer to more markets. Many OnePlus phones ship with Google Phone, while users in markets like India have access to the company’s own calling app, complete with features such as call recording without an audible announcement, AI-powered call summaries, and real-time translations. More users could eventually ditch Google’s dialer, although availability, including call recording support, will depend on the device and region.
The company is also considering bringing OPPO’s Calendar app to OnePlus phones, giving users another alternative to Google’s stock apps. Neither app has a confirmed timeline for wider availability.

OnePlus also shed some light on the cost of using its AI features, something we touched on in our recent ColorOS 17 hands-on with the OnePlus 15. While some features will remain free, others will have free usage limits. Once you exhaust your allowance, you’ll have two options: pay for additional usage or wait for your allowance to reset. The company hasn’t specified how much additional usage will cost or how frequently these allowances will reset.

As for the AI features themselves, OnePlus plans to introduce AI Photo Agent in a future update. The feature lets you edit photos using natural language commands, much like Google Photos’ Help Me Edit. Meanwhile, AI Mind Pilot availability will vary by device, software version, and region. The company is also evaluating whether it can bring 3D and AI Motion Wallpapers to more phones.

Music lovers wondering why lyrics aren’t showing up on their lock screens may have their streaming apps to blame. ColorOS 17 already supports the functionality, but music apps need to share lyrics with the system. OnePlus is working with app developers to expand compatibility.

Meanwhile, those experiencing increased battery drain or overheating after updating are advised to give their phones time to complete background optimizations. OnePlus hasn’t promised better battery life across all devices, but it says ColorOS 17 includes improvements to reduce micro-stutters during scrolling, app switching, and other everyday tasks.

Unfortunately, one familiar OnePlus feature isn’t making the transition to ColorOS. Typing “1+” followed by the equals button in the Calculator app will no longer bring up the iconic Never Settle Easter egg. It was among the little touches we highlighted when previewing what OnePlus users stood to lose with the switch to ColorOS, and OnePlus has now officially confirmed it’s gone.

cards.summary_cn: 【一加】TL;DR OnePlus 正在探索其原生手机应用程序的更广泛可用性，并计划将 OPPO 的日历应用程序引入其设备。 ColorOS 17 用户可以支付额外的人工智能使用费用，或者等待他们的免费全部……
fulltext_cn: Android Authority 上的附属链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解更多。
2026 年 11 月 26 日 — 下午 4:54（美国东部时间）
从 OxygenOS 到 ColorOS 的过渡给 OnePlus 手机带来了很多变化。尽管我们的许多读者已经熟悉了新软件，但并非所有内容都受到粉丝的好评。从缺失的功能到原生 OnePlus 应用程序的未来，该公司现在已经解决了围绕 ColorOS 17 的一些最大问题，揭示了用户可以从未来的更新中期待什么以及已经永远消失的内容。
在 OnePlus 社区论坛最近的 AMA 中，OnePlus 透露，它正在探索将其原生拨号器推向更多市场的计划。许多 OnePlus 手机都配备了 Google Phone，而印度等市场的用户可以使用该公司自己的通话应用程序，该应用程序具有诸如无声音通知的通话录音、人工智能驱动的通话摘要和实时翻译等功能。更多用户最终可能会放弃谷歌的拨号器，尽管可用性（包括通话录音支持）将取决于设备和地区。
该公司还考虑将 OPPO 的日历应用程序引入 OnePlus 手机，为用户提供谷歌库存应用程序之外的另一种选择。这两款应用程序都没有确定更广泛可用性的时间表。
OnePlus 还透露了使用其人工智能功能的成本，我们在最近的 OnePlus 15 的 ColorOS 17 实践中谈到了这一点。虽然某些功能将保持免费，但其他功能将有免费使用限制。一旦用完津贴，您将有两种选择：支付额外的使用费用或等待津贴重置。该公司尚未具体说明额外使用量将花费多少费用，也没有具体说明这些限额重置的频率。
至于AI功能本身，OnePlus计划在未来的更新中引入AI Photo Agent。该功能允许您使用自然语言命令编辑照片，就像 Google Photos 的 Help Me Edit 一样。同时，AI Mind Pilot 的可用性将因设备、软件版本和地区而异。该公司还在评估是否可以将3D和AI动态壁纸带到更多手机上。
音乐爱好者想知道为什么歌词没有显示在锁定屏幕上，这可能是他们的流媒体应用程序造成的。 ColorOS 17已经支持该功能，但音乐应用程序需要与系统共享歌词。 OnePlus 正在与应用程序开发人员合作以扩展兼容性。
同时，建议那些在更新后遇到电池消耗增加或过热的用户给手机一些时间来完成后台优化。 OnePlus 并未承诺在所有设备上提供更好的电池续航时间，但表示 ColorOS 17 进行了改进，以减少滚动、应用程序切换和其他日常任务期间的微卡顿。
不幸的是，一项熟悉的 OnePlus 功能并未过渡到 ColorOS。在计算器应用程序中输入“1+”，然后输入等于按钮将不再显示标志性的永不解决复活节彩蛋。这是我们在预览 OnePlus 用户因切换到 ColorOS 而可能失去的东西时强调的小细节之一，现在 OnePlus 已正式确认它已经消失。

cards.title: Small Actions, Big Impact: Give Back This Holiday Season With the Samsung Global Goals App
cards.title_cn: 小行动，大影响：通过三星全球目标应用回馈这个假期
cards.summary: 【Samsung】▲ The Samsung Global Goals app allows Galaxy users to work toward the Global Goals in an easy, collaborative way. The holidays are a time for giving back, and for Galaxy users, one of the easiest ways…
fulltext: Samsung Newsroom
on November 26, 2026

The holidays are a time for giving back, and for Galaxy users, one of the easiest ways to take part may already be on their phone. The Samsung Global Goals app,1 launched in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), gives the global Galaxy user community a simple way to support the UN’s 17 Global Goals2 for a better world.

Pick the cause you want to help most, from clean water and quality education to a peaceful society. Switch it up with every donation if you like, and see how your giving makes a difference. Prefer to give directly? You can also donate with your own funds. New payment options are being added in select markets.

As of the end of last year, Galaxy users had contributed around USD 24 million3 through Samsung Global Goals subscriptions, direct donations and ad views. Samsung also matches the donations generated by every ad viewed in the app, doubling the impact for the causes that matter most.
Explore each Goal and the facts behind it, then choose where your giving goes. Every donation supports UNDP’s work toward the Goals.
This holiday season, Samsung invites Galaxy users to give back and make a lasting change. To learn more, visit the Samsung Global Goals page.

cards.summary_cn: 【Samsung】▲ 三星全球目标应用程序允许 Galaxy 用户以简单、协作的方式努力实现全球目标。假期是回馈社会的时刻，对于 Galaxy 用户来说，最简单的方法之一是……
fulltext_cn: 三星新闻中心
假期是回馈社会的时刻，对于 Galaxy 用户来说，最简单的参与方式之一可能已经是在手机上。三星全球目标应用程序1与联合国开发计划署 (UNDP) 合作推出，为全球 Galaxy 用户社区提供了一种简单的方式来支持联合国的 17 项全球目标2，打造更美好的世界。
选择您最想帮助的事业，从清洁水和优质教育到和平社会。如果您愿意，可以在每次捐赠时切换它，看看您的捐赠如何产生影响。更愿意直接给予？您也可以用自己的资金捐款。部分市场正在添加新的支付选项。
截至去年底，Galaxy 用户通过三星全球目标订阅、直接捐赠和广告浏览贡献了约 2400 万美元3。三星还匹配应用程序中观看的每个广告所产生的捐款，从而使最重要的事业的影响加倍。
探索每个目标及其背后的事实，然后选择您的捐赠方向。每一笔捐款都支持开发计划署实现这些目标的工作。
这个假期，三星邀请 Galaxy 用户回馈并做出持久的改变。要了解更多信息，请访问三星全球目标页面。

cards.title: Samsung is bringing Galaxy Watch 9 health features to older Galaxy Watches
cards.title_cn: 三星将为旧款 Galaxy 手表带来 Galaxy Watch 9 健康功能
cards.summary: 【Android Authority】TL;DR Samsung is bringing six Galaxy Watch 9 health and fitness features to the Galaxy Watch 8 series. The upgrades include Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load, Fitness Index, improved Sleep…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Samsung could break its tradition of launching a new Galaxy Watch every year as early as 2027, reportedly shifting its focus to software updates and new health features for existing smartwatches. We’re already seeing what that approach could mean for Galaxy Watch owners, as Samsung has confirmed that several health and fitness features from the Galaxy Watch 9 are making their way to last year’s models.

The company began rolling out stable One UI 9 Watch to the Galaxy Watch 8 series in mid-November, with US users receiving the update shortly after. In a new announcement, Samsung has detailed six health and fitness upgrades originally introduced with the Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 that are coming to the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic.

Vitals tracks five overnight health metrics, including heart rate, skin temperature, and blood oxygen, to flag unusual changes in your readings. Heart Health Score, meanwhile, helps you understand how everyday habits like sleeping and exercising affect your heart. For fitness enthusiasts, Daily Cardio Load helps balance training and recovery, while Fitness Index assesses your overall fitness and suggests exercises based on your goals.
Samsung is also improving Sleep Coaching, which now requires just three nights of data within two weeks to offer personalized guidance. The advice adapts weekly as your sleeping habits change.

Earlier this month, Samsung began rolling out enhanced sleep apnea detection to its latest wearables, promising support for older Galaxy Watches. That upgrade is now reaching the Watch 8 series, offering three categories of breathing disruption frequency. Other additions include the Portrait Watch Face and an improved Compass that lets you save important locations and retrace your steps.

Perhaps even better, Samsung confirms that Daily Cardio Load and Fitness Index support the Galaxy Watch 7 running One UI 9 Watch, while the improved Sleep Coaching experience goes back as far as the Galaxy Watch 4.
Some features require separate updates to Samsung Health or Samsung Health Monitor, and availability may vary by region.

Whether or not Samsung skips next year’s smartwatch launch, bringing these features to hardware that can already support them gives existing Galaxy Watch owners fewer reasons to spend money on a new model.

cards.title_cn: 英伟达暂停向东南亚供应芯片
cards.summary: 【NVIDIA】Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

Nvidia is under pressure to do things differently, and a new WSJ report shows how far that’s going.

According to the Journal, Nvidia has told manufacturing partners, including Dell and Super Micro, to hit pause on server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia for an unspecified period as it assesses whether its regional partners are meeting U.S. export requirements.

As for why those countries, Chinese companies have been tapping Nvidia chips remotely from data centers there, a loophole the US Commerce Department closed — reportedly grudgingly — earlier this month. The Journal notes that the think tank Institute for Progress estimates remote data centers like these supply about 24% of China’s AI computing power.

cards.title: Best Black Friday headphone deals: Sony, Bose, AirPods, and more
cards.title_cn: 黑色星期五最佳耳机优惠：Sony、Bose、AirPods 等
cards.summary: 【Android Authority】Black Friday is one of the best times of the year to upgrade your audio, and 2026 has brought plenty worth upgrading to. Sony’s WF-1000XM6 earbuds landed in February, Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 4 Pro follo…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Black Friday is one of the best times of the year to upgrade your audio, and 2026 has brought plenty worth upgrading to. Sony’s WF-1000XM6 earbuds landed in February, Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 4 Pro followed in the spring, and Bose refreshed its popular QuietComfort Headphones over the summer. Many of these, along with favorites from Apple, Beats, and Nothing, are now at their lowest prices yet on Amazon.

We’ve rounded up the best headphone and earbud deals we could find, with picks at every price point, from premium noise cancelers to budget buys under $20. For savings on phones, smartwatches, and more, check out our main Black Friday deals hub.

Over-ear and on-ear headphones are the best choice for long listening sessions, flights, and blocking out a noisy commute. These Black Friday headphone deals cover everything from flagship noise canceling to excellent budget options.

The Sony WH-1000XM6 are Sony’s best noise-canceling headphones yet, and they’re among the best you can buy. They pair Sony’s QN3 processor with 12 microphones for class-leading noise canceling, and they fold up for travel, unlike the previous generation. You also get excellent sound, LDAC support, and up to 30 hours of battery life with ANC on. The Sony WH-1000XM6 are down to $348 on Amazon, a $112 (24%) saving and the lowest price Amazon has sold them for.

The Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) bring many of the features from Bose’s pricier QuietComfort Ultra line to a lighter, more affordable pair. That includes TrueSpatial immersive sound, ActiveSense adaptive noise canceling, and lossless audio over USB-C. At around 230g with a foldable design, they’re comfortable for hours, and the battery lasts up to 24 hours. The Hazelnut Taupe Bose QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) are $199 on Amazon, $160 (45%) off and their lowest price yet.

The Nothing Headphone (1) stand out with a striking transparent design, but there’s plenty of substance too. They’re tuned by KEF, support Hi-Res audio, and use satisfying physical controls, including a roller and paddle, instead of fiddly touch panels. Battery life is a highlight, with up to 80 hours of playback with ANC off and 35 hours with it on. The Nothing Headphone (1) are $169 on Amazon, saving you $130 (43%) and matching their lowest price.

The Beats Studio Pro are a great all-rounder for both iPhone and Android users, with one-touch pairing and full app support on both platforms. You get active noise canceling, a Transparency mode, Personalized Spatial Audio, and lossless audio over USB-C. Battery life runs up to 40 hours, and a quick 10-minute charge adds hours of playback. The Beats Studio Pro are $149 on Amazon, half their $299.99 list price.

The Sony WH-CH730N deliver dependable noise canceling and Sony’s signature sound for much less than its flagships. Their battery life is outstanding, with up to 50 hours with noise canceling on and 75 hours without, while a three-minute charge gives you an hour of listening. They’re also lightweight at 207g, foldable, and support multipoint and Bluetooth 6.0. The Sony WH-CH730N are $98 on Amazon, an $82 (46%) discount and the lowest price we’ve seen.

The JBL Tune 680NC show you don’t need to spend much for noise canceling. These on-ear headphones feature adaptive noise canceling with Smart Ambient, JBL Pure Bass sound, and multipoint connectivity, plus they fold flat for easy carrying. Battery life is huge at up to 76 hours, or 50 hours with ANC on, and a five-minute charge adds five hours of playback. The JBL Tune 680NC are $49.95 on Amazon, $60 (55%) off and the lowest price we’ve seen.

Earbuds are easier to carry everywhere, and this year’s Black Friday headphone deals include some of the best-ever prices on flagship models. There’s also a great option for anyone who just wants something cheap and reliable.

The Sony WF-1000XM6 are Sony’s latest flagship earbuds, and they’re a top pick for anyone who wants great sound and strong noise canceling in one package. Eight noise-canceling microphones and Sony’s QN3e chip help block out the world, while LDAC support gets the most out of compatible phones. You get eight hours of playback with ANC on, 24 hours with the case, and wireless charging. The Sony WF-1000XM6 are $248 on Amazon, an $82 (25%) saving and their lowest price yet.

The Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro are Samsung’s best earbuds yet and the natural choice for Galaxy phone owners. A two-way speaker setup delivers excellent sound, including 24-bit/96kHz audio on supported Galaxy devices, and adaptive noise control adjusts to your surroundings. They also add head gestures, Auracast support, and an IP57 rating, with up to seven hours of playback and 30 hours with the case. The Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro are $169.99 on Amazon, $80 (32%) off and their lowest price yet.

The Apple AirPods Pro 3 are the best earbuds for iPhone owners, and this is their best deal yet. Apple says the noise canceling is twice as effective as on the AirPods Pro 2, and the earbuds add built-in heart rate sensing for workouts, Live Translation, and hearing health features. They’re rated IP57 for sweat and water resistance and last up to eight hours with ANC on. The AirPods Pro 3 are down to $149 on Amazon, a $100 (40%) discount and their lowest price ever.

The Google Pixel Buds 2a bring active noise canceling to Google’s most affordable earbuds, powered by the same Tensor A1 chip as the Pixel Buds Pro 2. They’re light and comfortable, with a twist-to-adjust stabilizer, and work hand in hand with Gemini on Pixel and other Android phones. Battery life runs up to seven hours with ANC on, or 20 hours with the case. The Google Pixel Buds 2a are $99 on Amazon, $30 (23%) off and their lowest price yet.

The Beats Studio Buds Plus are a versatile pair of earbuds that work equally well with iPhones and Android phones, with one-touch pairing on both. They offer active noise canceling, a Transparency mode, and clear calls thanks to upgraded microphones, plus a total of up to 36 hours of battery life with the case. The translucent design is a fun touch too. The Beats Studio Buds Plus are $89.95 on Amazon, an $80 (47%) saving and their lowest price yet.

The CMF Buds 2a prove you can get noise canceling for less than $20. These budget earbuds from Nothing’s CMF brand feature 42dB hybrid ANC, big 12.4mm drivers for punchy bass, and four microphones for clear calls. They’re a great choice as a spare pair, a gift, or a first set of wireless earbuds. The CMF Buds 2a are $17.89 on Amazon, $11 (38%) off and the lowest price we’ve seen.

Apple AirPods Pro 3 是 iPhone 用户最好的耳机，这是他们迄今为止最优惠的价格。苹果表示，降噪效果是 AirPods Pro 2 的两倍，并且耳塞增加了内置心率感应功能，可用于锻炼、实时翻译和听力健康功能。它们的防汗防水等级为 IP57，在 ANC 开启的情况下可持续使用长达 8 小时。 AirPods Pro 3 在亚马逊上降至 149 美元，折扣 100 美元（40%），是有史以来的最低价格。

Google Pixel Buds 2a 为 Google 最实惠的耳塞带来主动降噪功能，采用与 Pixel Buds Pro 2 相同的 Tensor A1 芯片。它们轻便舒适，配有扭转调节稳定器，可与 Pixel 和其他 Android 手机上的 Gemini 协同工作。打开 ANC 时电池续航时间长达 7 小时，使用充电盒时电池续航时间长达 20 小时。 Google Pixel Buds 2a 在亚马逊上的售价为 99 美元，折扣 30 美元 (23%)，是迄今为止的最低价格。
Beats Studio Buds Plus 是一款多功能耳塞，与 iPhone 和 Android 手机同样适用，两者均可一键配对。它们提供主动降噪、通透模式和升级麦克风带来的清晰通话，加上充电盒的电池续航时间长达 36 小时。半透明的设计也很有趣。 Beats Studio Buds Plus 在亚马逊上的售价为 89.95 美元，节省了 80 美元（47%），是迄今为止的最低价格。
CMF Buds 2a 证明您可以以不到 20 美元的价格获得降噪功能。这些来自 Nothing 的 CMF 品牌的廉价耳塞配备 42dB 混合 ANC、可提供强劲低音的大型 12.4 毫米驱动器以及四个可实现清晰通话的麦克风。它们是作为备用耳机、礼物或第一套无线耳机的绝佳选择。 CMF Buds 2a 在亚马逊上的售价为 17.89 美元，折扣 11 美元（38%），是我们见过的最低价格。

cards.title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
cards.title_cn: 立即使用 GeForce 来参加游戏，为社区服务
cards.summary: 【NVIDIA】Good games bring people together. This GFN Thursday, GeForce NOW is celebrating the members, creators and community moderators who turn every session into something worth sharing. From friendships for…
fulltext: Share This Article
Good games bring people together. This GFN Thursday, GeForce NOW is celebrating the members, creators and community moderators who turn every session into something worth sharing.

From friendships formed in online lobbies to new worlds explored on everyday devices, GeForce NOW Ambassadors share their reasons to love cloud gaming. Those ready to find their own can get 30% off six-month Performance and Ultimate memberships in the Black Friday sale and a special seasonal offer through Amazon Fire TV Sticks.

Plus, War Thunder gets a new look with NVIDIA DLSS 5 for Ultimate members and a Ready for Battle Pack reward is now available across all membership tiers. Rounding out the week, 12 new games join the GeForce NOW library.
Behind every screenshot, helpful tip and play session is a gamer with a story. GeForce NOW Ambassadors share what keeps them playing.

For Discord moderator Luna, a low-spec laptop was the start of lasting connections: “Without GFN, I might’ve not been able to meet certain close friends … It has extended to me being given the privilege to be a moderator of an ever-growing community that links people together and continues to allow friends or partners to play with each other, regardless of what they own at home.”

After years helping moderate the community’s Reddit and Discord spaces, Hamza went from an aging laptop to cloud gaming across a TV, phone, tablet and desktop: “I’m genuinely thankful not just for the technology that keeps me gaming effortlessly wherever I am, but for the amazing community and friendships I’ve built along the way, and I look forward to what the future holds for cloud gaming.”

GeForce NOW kept new releases within reach for moderator Flacz, without needing frequent hardware upgrades: “GeForce NOW allowed me to enjoy games and adventures I’ve never imagined to be possible and it continues to be a part of my daily gaming experience till this day.”

For creators such as Warwick, playing is only part of the picture: “GFN has allowed me to play the games I want, as soon as they come out. The support GFN has given me to create content for them and be partnered with them means the world and encourages me to get better each day.”

Freedom to play and create resonates with Nads: “Being able to jump into my favorite games in an instant without worrying about downloads, storage limits or constant hardware upgrades feels like magic … Being able to play my game and stream on YouTube at the same time is something I never could have imagined before.”

Nigiri21Sushi also turns to the cloud when games stretch a local PC: “As a gaming content-creator, my current PC sometimes struggles showcasing new-release games that are CPU/GPU-intensive … Hence, huge thank you to GFN for allowing me to produce fluid content via cloud-gaming.”

For Marchief, demanding games on Steam Deck are the draw: “I’m thankful that GeForce NOW allows me to play the top AAA games on the Steam Deck … Having the power of an RTX 5080 in a handheld is just absolutely mindblowing.”
Markys enjoys the comfort of the couch with his favorite game, World of Warcraft: Forever: “No high-end gaming PC needed, just my controller, my TV and the freedom to play wherever I want.”
Anytime Anywhere Gaming shared a video that shared why GeForce NOW is “really fantastic in a whole lot of ways.”
Keep the conversation going on the community-run GeForce NOW Reddit and Discord.

There’s still time to save 30% on the first six-month term of a Performance or Ultimate membership. The Black Friday sale runs through Monday, Nov. 30, for new memberships and eligible upgrades in select regions, while supplies last.

Go Ultimate for GeForce RTX 5080-class performance across PCs, Macs, Steam Deck and other supported handhelds, mobile devices, compatible TVs and more. Experience DLSS 5 in supported games, ray tracing and streaming at up to 5K resolution or up to 360 frames per second, with sessions lasting up to eight hours. GeForce NOW handles downloads, patches and updates for Ready-to-Play games, saving local storage for everyday essentials.
Choose a six-month membership before the sale wraps up and settle in for a season of gaming.

For big-screen play, GeForce NOW also supports Amazon Fire TV Stick devices, with a separate offer for 90% off the first month of Performance or Ultimate when purchased directly through Amazon in participating regions. Check out the supported devices and offer details.

Gaijin Entertainment’s War Thunder now supports NVIDIA DLSS 5 on GeForce NOW, bringing air, land and naval combat into sharper focus. Its 3D-Guided Neural Rendering technology adds lifelike lighting and materials, from tank armor to the water around a warship.

Ultimate members can experience the visual update with GeForce RTX 5080-class performance in the cloud across supported devices, without an expensive PC upgrade. Keep the focus on the next maneuver and let GeForce NOW handle the power in the cloud.
To celebrate, GeForce NOW members across all membership tiers can claim the Ready for Battle Pack, now available.

The pack includes an M3A1 Stuart tank and F2A-1 aircraft, each with a unique skin, seven days of Premium account time, 100,000 Silver Lions, a 50% booster for Research Points and Silver Lions, and the “Overclocked” title.

Sign in to a GeForce NOW account and head to the Account Portal to claim the reward code, then activate it on Gaijin’s redemption page. The reward is available through Friday, Dec. 25, at 11:59 p.m. PT, or while supplies last, with a limit of one per customer. Keep the great gaming going with this week’s additions to the GeForce NOW library:

Plus, Ultimate Members streaming from RTX 5080 cloud gaming rigs can experience Where Winds Meet with DLSS 5, enhancing the environments and characters of its wuxia open-world action role-playing game.

Dates listed above reflect when games are released on their respective stores. GeForce NOW availability may vary, as games are onboarded after release and added throughout the week. Keep an eye on GeForce NOW channels and GFN Thursdays for availability updates on announced titles.
Experience the best in GeForce NOW cloud gaming. Grab a day pass to try Performance or Ultimate before committing to a monthly membership, with the day pass cost applicable toward that first month.
What’s the best part of gaming with GeForce NOW? Share it on X or in the comments below.

cards.summary_cn: 【NVIDIA】好的游戏可以将人们聚集在一起。这个 GFN 周四，GeForce NOW 向会员、创作者和社区版主致敬，他们将每一次会议都变成了值得分享的内容。来自友谊……
fulltext_cn: 分享这篇文章
好的游戏可以将人们聚集在一起。这个 GFN 周四，GeForce NOW 向会员、创作者和社区版主致敬，他们将每一次会议都变成了值得分享的内容。
从在线大厅中建立的友谊到在日常设备上探索的新世界，GeForce NOW 大使分享了他们喜爱云游戏的原因。那些准备好找到自己的会员的人可以在黑色星期五促销中获得 6 个月 Performance 和 Ultimate 会员资格 30% 的折扣，并通过 Amazon Fire TV Sticks 享受特别季节性优惠。
此外，War Thunder 还为 Ultimate 会员提供了 NVIDIA DLSS 5 的全新外观，并且现在所有会员级别均可获得 Ready for Battle Pack 奖励。本周，GeForce NOW 库新增 12 款新游戏。
每个屏幕截图、有用的提示和游戏会话的背后都是一个有故事的游戏玩家。 GeForce NOW 大使分享了他们玩游戏的动力。
对于 Discord 版主 Luna 来说，一台低配置的笔记本电脑是持久联系的开始：“如果没有 GFN，我可能无法见到某些亲密的朋友……它让我有幸成为一个不断发展的社区的版主，这个社区将人们联系在一起，并继续允许朋友或伙伴互相玩耍，无论他们家里有什么。”
在帮助管理社区的 Reddit 和 Discord 空间多年后，Hamza 从一台老化的笔记本电脑转向了电视、手机、平板电脑和台式机上的云游戏：“我真诚地感谢技术，不仅让我无论身在何处都能轻松玩游戏，而且感谢我一路走来建立的令人惊叹的社区和友谊，我对云游戏的未来充满期待。”
GeForce NOW 让版主 Flacz 能够轻松发布新版本，而无需频繁升级硬件：“GeForce NOW 让我能够享受从未想象过的游戏和冒险，直到今天，它仍然是我日常游戏体验的一部分。”
对于像 Warwick 这样的创作者来说，玩只是游戏的一部分：“GFN 让我能够在游戏推出后立即玩到我想要的游戏。GFN 给予我为他们创作内容并与他们合作的支持意味着整个世界，并鼓励我每天变得更好。”
自由地玩耍和创作引起了 Nads 的共鸣：“能够立即跳入我最喜欢的游戏，而无需担心下载、存储限制或不断的硬件升级，感觉就像魔法一样……能够一边玩我的游戏，一边在 YouTube 上进行流媒体播放，这是我以前从未想象过的。”
当游戏扩展本地 PC 时，Nigiri21Sushi 也会转向云：“作为游戏内容创建者，我当前的 PC 有时难以展示 CPU/GPU 密集型的新发布游戏……因此，非常感谢 GFN 允许我通过云游戏制作流畅的内容。”
对于 Marchief 来说，Steam Deck 上的高要求游戏很有吸引力：“我很感激 GeForce NOW 允许我在 Steam Deck 上玩顶级 AAA 游戏……在手持设备上拥有 RTX 5080 的强大功能绝对令人兴奋。”
Markys 喜欢在舒适的沙发上玩他最喜欢的游戏《魔兽世界：永远》：“不需要高端游戏电脑，只需要我的控制器、我的电视以及随心所欲地玩游戏的自由。”
Anytime Anywhere Gaming 分享了一段视频，讲述了为何 GeForce NOW “在很多方面都非常出色”。
在社区运营的 GeForce NOW Reddit 和 Discord 上继续对话。
在 Performance 或 Ultimate 会员的前六个月期限内，仍有时间节省 30%。黑色星期五促销活动持续至 11 月 30 日星期一，针对特定地区的新会员和符合条件的升级，售完即止。
在 PC、Mac、Steam Deck 和其他受支持的手持设备、移动设备、兼容电视等设备上实现 GeForce RTX 5080 级性能。在支持的游戏中体验 DLSS 5、光线追踪和高达 5K 分辨率或高达每秒 360 帧的流媒体，会话持续长达八小时。 GeForce NOW 可以处理即玩型游戏的下载、补丁和更新，为日常必需品节省本地存储空间。
在特卖结束前选择六个月的会员资格，并享受一个游戏季节。
对于大屏幕游戏，GeForce NOW 还支持 Amazon Fire TV Stick 设备，在参与地区直接通过 Amazon 购买时，可单独享受 Performance 或 Ultimate 首月 90% 的折扣。查看支持的设备并提供详细信息。
Gaijin Entertainment 的 War Thunder 现在支持 GeForce NOW 上的 NVIDIA DLSS 5，使空中、陆地和海上战斗更加清晰。其 3D 引导神经渲染技术添加了逼真的灯光和材质，从坦克装甲到军舰周围的水域。
Ultimate 会员可以在受支持的设备上在云端体验 GeForce RTX 5080 级性能的视觉更新，而无需进行昂贵的 PC 升级。将注意力集中在下一个策略上，让 GeForce NOW 处理云端的力量。
为了庆祝，所有会员级别的 GeForce NOW 会员都可以领取现已推出的 Ready for Battle Pack。
该包包括一辆 M3A1 斯图亚特坦克和 F2A-1 飞机，每架都有独特的皮肤、7 天的高级帐户时间、100,000 银狮、50% 的研究点和银狮助推器以及“超频”头衔。
登录 GeForce NOW 帐户并前往帐户门户领取奖励代码，然后在 Gaijin 的兑换页面上激活它。奖励截止日期为 12 月 25 日星期五晚上 11:59。 PT，即售完即止，每位顾客限购一份。通过本周 GeForce NOW 库的新增内容，让精彩的游戏继续进行：
此外，从 RTX 5080 云游戏平台串流的终极会员还可以通过 DLSS 5 体验《风声交汇》，从而增强其武侠开放世界动作角色扮演游戏的环境和角色。
上面列出的日期反映了游戏在各自商店发布的时间。 GeForce NOW 的可用性可能会有所不同，因为游戏会在发布后加入并在整个星期内添加。请密切关注 GeForce NOW 频道和 GFN 星期四，了解已发布游戏的可用性更新。
体验 GeForce NOW 云游戏的最佳体验。在成为月度会员之前，先购买一张一日通行证来尝试 Performance 或 Ultimate，一日通行证费用适用于第一个月。
使用 GeForce NOW 玩游戏最棒的部分是什么？在 X 上或在下面的评论中分享。
